# Retained local dependency snapshot

LilyGo-display-library contains the src tree, library.properties and LICENSE from the installed 0.1.0 library used for the local builds. The library metadata identifies LILYGO and https://github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/LilyGo-display-library. The retained license identifies MIT and copyright 2026 LILYGO. No license has been chosen for WardriveHub itself.

This snapshot is recorded by file hashes in SHA256SUMS.txt. Its exact upstream commit and local modification history are unknown; do not claim an upstream tag was reproduced. The snapshot is retained so the C5 T-Dongle header does not depend on an unpinned download. Build utilities explicitly select this directory. Other display-board profiles in the library do not establish WardriveHub support for those devices.

Examples, editor settings and unrelated assets from the installed library are excluded. All retained source and license bytes are unchanged. Other dependencies remain versioned external installations; see docs/BUILD.md.
